subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: an aged tempera fable painting on an old wood panel: cracked, faded pigment with fine craquelure, soft muted color, folk storybook composition and visible dry-brush texture.
<Subject 2> is the abandoned town in both pictures: narrow streets of old plaster and adobe houses with clay-tile roofs and wooden shutters, completely empty of people, and a small whitewashed church with a bell tower.
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing the end of the same street at night, the small whitewashed church closing the view in the center with its bell tower rising above and a bronze bell in the open arch, warm windows still glowing on both sides, fog drifting low over the wet cobblestones.
<Picture 2> is the last frame of [Shot 1], showing a high view from just above the clay-tile rooftops at the first light of dawn, looking toward the church bell tower in the center, a thin line of golden light opening on the far horizon, a few windows below still glowing faintly, fog lying in the narrow streets, small birds lifting off the roof tiles.

detailed_description:
The target video is a living aged tempera painting in <Subject 1>: the cracked pigment and dry-brush texture stay visible on every surface as it moves, and the light changes like paint glazing over paint.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The bronze bell in the open arch begins to swing gently by itself. The camera rises slowly straight up at a steady speed in one continuous move, the church facade sliding down and the clay-tile rooftops spreading out below as the camera clears them, the bell tower staying in the center the whole time. On the far horizon a thin line of golden dawn light opens and slowly spreads, the windows below fade from warm yellow, and a flock of small birds lifts off the roof tiles. The camera is still rising as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
The church bell rings out once, full and slow, its hum fading into the wind over the rooftops. Bird wings flutter as the flock lifts off, and the first quiet birdsong of dawn begins.
